change: Bounded productive plural-pronoun/assistance grammar, authored word priorities, decaying explicit correction feedback and transient Single selection assembly learning. No language model retraining or unknown sentence persistence.

authored_development_cases.note: Authored examples are development behavior checks, not real user accuracy.

learning_limits: Opt-in, local only; protected fields excluded. Saves existing single-character/known-word keys; selected spans are transient and reset on code discontinuity, mode switch or completion. Corrections require an explicit replacement, decay with 7-day half-life, bounded to 512 entries. No inference from merely unselected candidates.
